value.name: Asha dials the phone
value.description: Asha presses the phone and initiates a call after hesitating over what voice to use.
evidence: she pressed it before she had decided what voice she was going to use when a stranger picked up

value.name: Asha realizes Marcus lied about the wire
value.description: As the phone rings, Asha understands that Marcus had invented a wire he did not actually have.
evidence: she understood that Marcus had sat across from her in that Trenton hallway and named a wire he did not have

value.name: Asha decides she cannot avoid the conversation
value.description: She recognizes that this is a problem she cannot handle through work routines or paperwork.
evidence: this was the part of the week she could not bill or file her way through

value.name: Asha lets the call continue
value.description: When the second ring begins, Asha chooses not to hang up.
evidence: The second ring began, and she did not hang up

value.name: Claire answers from a domestic apartment
value.description: The call connects to Claire in a lived-in apartment with household sounds and a child in the background.
evidence: The second ring cut off mid-tone and the line opened onto a small domestic acoustic—a refrigerator hum, a child somewhere far back in the apartment, a chair being pushed against tile

value.name: Asha refuses to greet Claire
value.description: Asha stays silent instead of saying hello and waits for Claire to speak first.
evidence: she waited, because she had spent the drive back from Devin's deciding she would not be the one to give this conversation its shape

value.name: Claire apologizes and reveals she expected the call
value.description: Claire says she is sorry, had hoped Asha would call that night, and admits Marcus does not know she wrote.
evidence: A woman cleared her throat on the other end and said, careful and tired, that she was sorry, that she had hoped Asha would call tonight, that Marcus did not know she had written

value.name: Asha senses Claire's loneliness
value.description: Asha hears in the background that Claire has been alone for hours waiting for the phone to ring.
evidence: she heard, behind Claire's voice, the particular flatness of a room where someone has been sitting alone for hours waiting for a phone to ring

value.name: Asha withholds response to control the exchange
value.description: Asha keeps the silence going beyond politeness to force Claire to reveal more.
evidence: Asha held the silence past the point of politeness
Claire did not fill it, which told Asha something useful
